Bot flow reviewed in code only.

minor.issue: The staged upload is deleted (findOneAndDelete) BEFORE the wallet check, so a 402 insufficient_balance uses up the stage. The UI keeps the quote after a 402 (it only resets on 'expired'), so after topping up, Send gives 410 'upload expired' and the user has to upload again. Do the balance check before deleting the stage, or put the stage back when it fails.

Staged uploads have no TTL and no cleanup. Cancelled or abandoned stages leave faxStaged docs and GridFS faxFiles behind forever, so the 'upload expired' message only shows when a stage is reused. Add a TTL index on faxStaged.createdAt and delete the orphaned GridFS files.

The wallet check doesn't count paid pages on faxes that are queued but not yet delivered. Several paid faxes sent close together can each pass the check, and then forceWalletDebit on delivery takes the wallet negative.

A stage isn't tied to the From number. A stage made on number A can be sent from number B, and B's allowance is used. The UI blocks this by resetting the stage when From changes, but the API allows it.

ui_bugs.issue: After a send or Cancel, the file state is cleared but the hidden <input type=file> value is not. Picking the same file again may not fire onChange, so the button stays disabled. Fix: set e.target.value = '' after reading the file, or clear it with a ref.

integration_issues.issue: A row stays 'Queued' until the user clicks Refresh. There's no polling or SSE refresh when the delivered notification arrives.

issues: The fax-line Toggle in the off state is almost invisible: a white/very light track on a white card with a faint border. Raise the contrast of the off-state track.

action_items: Move the wallet check in sendStaged before findOneAndDelete of the stage, or restore the stage on 402
Add TTL/cleanup for faxStaged and orphaned GridFS staged files
